overview_sentence: Experimental error is the scatter in a response that remains after the controlled factors are accounted for.

self_checks.title: Two treatments
self_checks.prompt: Observations (3,5) and (8,10) have treatment means 4 and 9 and grand mean 6.5. What are the treatment and error sums of squares?
self_checks.answer: The treatment sum of squares is 25 and the error sum of squares is 4.

self_checks.title: Error mean square
self_checks.prompt: The error sum of squares is 4 on 2 degrees of freedom. What is the error mean square?

self_checks.title: A second split
self_checks.prompt: Observations (1,3) and (5,7) have means 2 and 6 and grand mean 4. What are the two sums of squares?
self_checks.answer: The treatment sum of squares is 16 and the error sum of squares is 4.
